_comment: Accepted parity tolerance gates, per optimization phase. Keys are path prefixes into the parity_dump JSON; unmatched keys require bit-identical results. Class B = fp reassociation/FMA-contraction (<=1e-12 on evaluations); fitted parameters may drift up to 1e-8 while the loglik optimum stays fixed (class C).
_comment_bb_hinv: closed-form hfuncs reassociate fp ops; the 35-sweep bisection amplifies ulp shifts up to its own bracket width (~3e-11)
_comment_tau: tau integrands reformulated and integrated with tanh-sinh (split at the peak for extreme-value families); interior lattice points move <=5e-9, the near-boundary *_edge sweeps by far more because they were wrong before -- see test_bicop_sanity_checks for 50-digit references
_comment_tawn: fused Pickands: optimizer endpoint may shift, loglik optimum unchanged
_comment_bb8: vectorized pdf: BOBYQA endpoint drifts along BB8's flat theta/delta ridge (|dloglik| ~ 1e-8 for |dpar| ~ 4e-5); loglik stays gated at 1e-8
_comment_student_par: vectorized elliptical leaves + log-pdf pathway nudge BOBYQA's endpoint along Student's flat (rho,nu) ridge (~1.2e-8); loglik optimum unchanged (rel ~1e-13)
_comment_bb6_par: safeguarded-Newton h-inverse sharpens the simulated fit data (~1e-10/point), nudging BOBYQA's endpoint along BB6's flat ridge to ~1.6e-8; loglik optimum unchanged (rel ~1e-10)
_comment_ulp: raw-pointer _or_nan loops and NullaryExpr fills reorder fp ops at the ulp level in the mcor path
_comment_tll_disc: the discrete latent sample is now drawn from pseudo-random rather than quasi-random numbers: a low-discrepancy sequence is a near-lattice whose coordinates are negatively dependent by construction, so using it as per-observation noise attenuated the recovered dependence by up to 0.35 in Kendall's tau. Every discrete TLL fit moves; observed max 0.34 on pdf, 0.11 on loglik (#742)
_comment_qnorm: SIMD qnorm shifts gaussian evaluations ~1e-15; finite-difference scores (/h) and hessian (/h^2) on the pre-derivatives base amplify that to ~1e-12 and ~1e-10
_comment_tll_normalization: margin normalization now averages the two row/column sweep orders and iterates to a tolerance instead of running three fixed sweeps, and cond_cdf/cond_quantile no longer floor the interpolated density at 1e-4. Every continuous TLL quantity moves; observed maxima are 6.2e-4 on the grid, 5.7e-4 on pdf, 1.3e-4 on hfunc, 8.6e-5 on hinv, 2.2e-5 on loglik and 1.0e-5 on cdf (#742)
_comment_tll_hinv: direct inversion is exact; baseline bisection had ~3e-11 error. Widened with the normalization change above
_comment_tll_fit: fixed-size influence inverse + broadcast reassociation (ulp-level). npars is unaffected by the normalization change, so it stays gated tightly
